demonstration_summary.title: ${var.title} complete
demonstration_summary.summary: The walkthrough narrowed a supplied dashboard, interacted with the relevant panel, and opened supporting detail.

checks.title: Context
checks.detail: Time and global controls were narrowed.

checks.title: Panel
checks.detail: The relevant value or calculation was inspected.

checks.title: Evidence
checks.detail: Underlying data preserved the investigation context.

demonstration_summary.evidence: The dashboard interaction and underlying result support the conclusion.

answer.evidence: The supplied dashboard and underlying data support this conclusion.

goals.title: Narrow the supplied dashboard
goals.concept: Global time, filters, and controls apply context across panels.
goals.narration: Narrow the dashboard to the relevant interval and scope.
goals.reasoning: A shared context makes panel comparisons meaningful.
goals.evidence: The dashboard refreshes with the narrowed state.
hints: Use the context shared by all dashboard panels.
Look at the time picker, filters, and controls above the panels.
Narrow on ${var.field}; Show me can demonstrate the supplied control.

goals.title: Interact with the decisive panel
goals.concept: Legend and value interactions can isolate a series without editing the dashboard.
goals.narration: Select the panel value that represents the abnormal segment.
goals.reasoning: The selected series identifies the scope of impact.
goals.evidence: The dashboard retains the selected value as investigation context.
hints: Find the panel that directly answers the operational question.
Use its legend or a chart value in view mode.
Select the ${truth.finding} series; Show me can point it out.

goals.title: Open supporting panel evidence
goals.concept: Inspection and drilldowns explain calculation scope and connect aggregates to records.
goals.narration: Inspect the panel or open its underlying data with context intact.
goals.reasoning: This verifies that the chart means what the conclusion claims.
goals.evidence: The underlying or inspection view contains corroborating evidence.
hints: Verify the aggregate against its source or calculation.
Use the panel menu, inspection view, or configured drilldown.
Open underlying data; Show me can demonstrate the read-only path.

goals.title: Submit a dashboard-supported conclusion
goals.concept: Cite both the visual pattern and the supporting detail.
goals.narration: Record the conclusion without editing or saving content.
goals.reasoning: A view-only investigation should still produce a reproducible evidence chain.
goals.evidence: The response cites the panel and underlying data.
hints: Use the coach form, not dashboard edit mode.
Include finding, scope, conclusion, and evidence.
